保留标题、列表、粗体、斜体、链接和表格: Headings, lists, bold, italic, links and tables are kept
修订按全部接受处理: Tracked changes are taken as all accepted

只取图标里最大的一张: Only the largest image in the icon is taken
只取第一帧: Only the first frame is taken
只提取文字，图片、表格和版式不保留: Only the text is extracted; pictures, tables and layout aren't kept
只有一页，不用拆分: Only one page, nothing to split
只留值：公式取上次算好的结果，日期写成 2026-10-25，小数位数照格式，百: Only values are kept: formulas give their last calculated result, dates are written as 2026-10-25, decimals follow the number format, and percent signs, currency symbols and thousands separators aren't kept
只留文字，格式、图片、页眉页脚和脚注不保留: Only the text is kept; formatting, pictures, headers, footers and footnotes aren't
只留文字：每张幻灯片先写标题，再写各个文本框、表格和 SmartArt 的文字，: Only the text is kept: for each slide its title, then the text of each text box, table and SmartArt, then the notes
合并单元格的值只在左上角一格，样式、批注和图表不保留: A merged cell's value is only in its top-left cell; styles, comments and charts aren't kept
图标最大 256×256，大图会缩小: Icons are at most 256×256; bigger images are shrunk
图片、图表、动画和版式不保留: Pictures, charts, animations and layout aren't kept
图片、字体、颜色、页眉页脚和脚注不保留，标题的自动编号也不保留: Pictures, fonts, colors, headers, footers and footnotes aren't kept, nor are heading numbers

多页 TIFF 每页一页: Each page of a multi-page TIFF becomes a page
已经很小，压缩后没有变小: Already small; no smaller after compressing

扫描件没有文字层，提取不出文字；带文字层的扫描件只保留文字: A scan has no text layer, so no text comes out; a scan with a text layer keeps only the text

按 SVG 标明的尺寸转成位图: Drawn as pixels at the size the SVG gives
按段落重建：分栏、表格、页眉页脚不保留，字体换成默认字体: Rebuilt paragraph by paragraph: columns, tables, headers and footers aren't kept, and fonts become the default
数字写成数字，小数位数照原样显示；以 0 开头的编号和超过 15 位的数字按文字: Numbers are written as numbers, showing the decimals they had; codes starting with 0 and numbers over 15 digits are kept as text
无损保存，画质不会再降低: Saved losslessly, so the quality drops no further
无损格式不会补回已丢失的细节，文件会变大: A lossless format can't bring back detail already lost, and the file gets bigger
日期、百分比和其他内容都按文字保留: Dates, percentages and everything else are kept as text
有损压缩，文字和线条边缘可能出现杂点: Lossy compression; the edges of text and lines may get speckles
样式、位置和特效会丢失: Styles, positions and effects are lost

每行一段，用 Word 默认字体: One paragraph per line, in Word's default font

符号链接和 Unix 权限不保留: Symbolic links and Unix permissions aren't kept
